scope: Spline phi_h bin-centering sampling sub_phi_9. 3D BC_RC_Bayesian in the copy of alternatives/spline/sub_phi_9/histograms.root, Q2-y 1-17. Bayesian, RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D were absent and were not created. Bin-centering factors were not rebuilt. Comparison with the refined spline BC nominal is later and was not used to move these parameters. No publication. The source file was not edited.
start_mode: spline. start=auto: a BC_RC histogram selects untagged or BC keys, not the tight 3D acceptance windows. Those selected B widths have median 0.17, and 305 of 452 bins leave B unlimited. The run-local guide started as Prepare_Next_Iteration/Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_from_Spline.py. --use_spline_init was not also passed.
changed: Pass 1 reproduced the stored manual-initializer fit in 451 bins. (Q2_y_Bin_15)-(z_pT_Bin_24) already had a (15, 24, 3D, BC) key in the spline file and improved from chi-squared 45.490 to 40.358. Pass 2 opened (q, z, 3D, BC) windows for histograms whose own weighted cosine was outside a limit or had been collapsed by the second fit pass. 22 bins improved and none got worse. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) left the legacy BC window B [-0.03, 0.05] and C [0, 0.1]: B -0.0429 to -0.1084 (error 0.0340), C 9.594e-13 to -0.0459 (error 0.0320), chi-squared 43.713 to 39.262, NDF 13. That start is this histogram's cosine, not the nominal value. (6, 2) and (5, 6) were in that same guided pass. JSON still has 452 bins.
left_bins: (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_7) and (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_6) already match their own cosines, so their shifts versus the refined spline BC nominal were kept. Bins whose unconstrained cosine does not lower chi-squared stay, including the high-chi-squared shapes listed as unresolved. (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_6) was opened because its B was outside [-0.5, -0.3]; chi-squared fell from 48.568 to 43.868. (Q2_y_Bin_9)-(z_pT_Bin_7) still sits on the second-pass C edge at 0.06, with only about 3.5 of chi-squared left, so that limit was not opened. Five bins already had a collapsed parameter error in the stored fit and were unchanged: (1,10), (2,14), (4,29), (5,7), and (8,30). No 5D family. Excluded sectors are not in these files. Missing comparisons were not filled with zero.

why_retained: Every changed bin has a lower chi-squared on its own histogram than the stored fit, and no other bin got worse. (1, 8) is lower chi-squared than the legacy-limit fit and was not replaced by the nominal parameters. Large nominal-minus-variation shifts that already follow the points were not shrunk.
